terra.problem: The text does not say how anyone felt on finding the scroll, or that it had been in Ecbatana the whole time.
The explanation is flat and repeats that Nineveh is not mentioned without adding any distinctive voice.
The decree orders the gold and silver articles returned. It does not say everything carried off was returned, or report their return here.
The text does not say Darius saw the memo or that there was nothing left to investigate.
The decree says the costs are to be paid so the work will not be hindered. It does not say the builders never had to wait for money or that the king paid on time.
The passage names the priests as the ones requesting supplies, but does not state here that the offerings go through them.
The explanation is a generic correction and restatement, with little of Papa Dorin's voice.
The passage calls it the Book of Moses but does not say here that Moses wrote it.
The passage says all the priests and Levites were clean, not that everyone was clean. It also does not say their purification happened before Passover began.
